p: He adds certain general exhortations, and at length ends his epistle with various familiar and godly salutations.
Continue in prayer: Prayers must be continual and earnest.
Withal praying also for us: Those who minister the word, must especially be entrusted to the prayers of the Church.
door of utterance: An open and free mouth to preach the Gospel.
Walk: In all parts of our life, we ought to have good consideration even of those who are outside of the Church.
in wisdom toward them that are: Advisedly and cautiously.
time: Seek occasion to win them, even though you lose something of your own by it.
Let your speech be alway with: Our speech and talk must be applied to the profit of the hearers.
grace: Fit for the profit of your neighbour.
salt: Against this is set filthy communication, as in Eph 4:29.
only are my fellowworkers unto the: Hence, Peter was not at that time in Rome.
kingdom of God: In the Gospel.
